items.title: Pressure intensifies on Carrick as Man Utd lose to Bournemouth
items.summary: Manchester United's winless run stretches to eight matches in all competitions as they're beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth at Old Trafford - a defeat that leaves United's manager Michael Carrick under severe pressure.

items.title: End approaching for Carrick but Man Utd owners' problems far bigger
items.summary: Manchester United's fans sang their support for Michael Carrick during the 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth, but voiced there opposition to virtually everything else.

items.title: Howe open to Man Utd talks - Monday's gossip
items.summary: Eddie Howe is open to holding talks with Manchester United if they part ways with manager Michael Carrick, three Premier League clubs are monitoring Bayern Munich's Lennart Karl, plus more.

items.title: Ex-Premier League ace Jermaine Pennant left needing 50 stitches after dog mauls him – before own pet fights off attacker
items.summary: EX-Premier League star Jermaine Pennant needed more than 50 stitches after a dog repeatedly sank its teeth into his leg. items.title: Birmingham get first win of the season after edging past Charlton
items.summary: Wilda Leidhammar scores as Birmingham secure their first WSL win this season, beating bottom club Charlton 1-0 at St Andrew's, as the away side's wait for a first point goes on.

items.title: City's perfect start ended in derby draw with Man Utd
items.summary: A late equaliser from Elisabeth Terland earned Manchester United a well-earned 1-1 draw that ended Manchester City's perfect start to the WSL campaign.

items.title: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over Brighton
items.summary: An own goal from Brighton's Pascal Gross swiftly followed by a goal from Alexander Isak, sees Liverpool beat the Seagulls 2-0 at Anfield to move into the Premier League top four.

items.title: Sage continues to struggle as Palace lose at home to Newcastle
items.summary: Crystal Palace's winless run stretches to four matches as they're beaten 2-0 at home by Newcastle, leaving the club just a point outside the relegation zone with the pressure mounting on manager Pierre Sage.

items.title: Hull draw third consecutive home game after being held by Brentford
items.summary: Hull draw a third consecutive home game after Dango Ouattara's equaliser helps Brentford grab a point in a 1-1 draw at the MKM Stadium in the Premier League.

items.title: Sunderland stay bottom after goalless draw with Leeds
items.summary: Sunderland remain bottom of the Premier League after a goalless draw with Leeds in difficult conditions at the Stadium of Light.

items.title: Late own goal gives Liverpool point against London City Lionesses
items.summary: A stoppage time own goal from Jana Fernandez sees Liverpool snatch a point against London City Lionesses, as the two sides draw 2-2 in the Women's Super League.

items.title: Vangsgaard scores twice as Villa hang on to beat Everton
items.summary: Amalie Vangsgaard scores twice for Aston Villa as the away side survive a late fightback from Everton to win 3-2 at Goodison Park in the Women's Super League.

items.title: Terland strikes late as United end Manchester City’s winning start in WSL
items.summary: At long last, a weakness has been spotted.
